newsitem.title: HUNGARY: PICK DENIES WINNING TENDER FOR COMPETITOR.
newsitem.headline: PICK DENIES WINNING TENDER FOR COMPETITOR.

text.p: Hungarian meat processor Pick Szeged Rt on Monday denied press information that it had won a privatisation tender for its competitor Ringa Rt.
"News published in the daily Nepszabadsag that Pick won the tender published for the privatisation of Ringa Rt, is not true," Pick said in a statement.

Nepszabadsag said on Monday that the board of the state privatisation agency APV will make a formal decision on Ringa's privatisation on Wednesday but the agency had virtually decided to sell a 51 percent stake in Ringa to Pick.
Pick's sole competitor in the tender was Hungary's Timesco Investment and Development Rt, Nepszabadsag said.
The paper added that with the acquisiton of Ringa, Pick would have a 30 percent market stake in Hungary's pork meat processing.
"With this, (Pick) may get into a monopoly position, in which it can dictate purchase and sales prices," the paper said.
Pick Rt sticks some 540,000 pigs a year while Ringa, which is market leader in Hungary's northwest region, has 400,000, Nepszabadsag said.
Pick closed at 13,495 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Friday.
